title: Unit-cost Minimap and Pricing Patterns — compact token-level cost explorer and export
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: customers need a compact, scannable way to understand per-token economics across many routes and prompts and to export fine-grained line items for downstream chargebacks and billing reconciliations. Existing Console views assume wide dashboards and lose fidelity when users want token-level rows or to preview pricing model impact (per-token vs slab vs subscription).

Goal: design a compact "minimap" UI element and a complementary pricing-pattern selector that surface token-level unit costs, attribution, and an export-first workflow. The minimap should act as both a dense overview (sparklines + hotspots) and an entry point to row-expansion for details. The pricing-pattern selector should let users preview and switch pricing policies for hypothetical cost scenarios and export line-item CSVs that reflect chosen pricing patterns.

Scope (this ticket): 1) high-fidelity Figma prototype of the minimap and expanded row, 2) pricing-pattern selector patterns (slab, per-token tiered, fixed subscription), 3) export wizard UI with sampling controls and estimated CSV size, 4) accessibility and responsive behavior for narrow consoles (compact mode). Not in scope: backend billing transformation logic (ENG ticket to implement mappings).

Key UX principles: density with clarity, reversible preview (no destructive price changes), progressive disclosure, clear attribution links back to prompts and routes, and export-first affordances (preview rows, estimated file size, sampling options).
acceptance_criteria: Minimap prototype in Figma that shows compact rows with 1) sparkline of cost per time slice, 2) hotspot markers for spikes, 3) aggregated per-token average metric
Row expansion reveals exact token counts, model variant, prompt-template, and breakdown (generation vs prompt tokens) and an action to export that row
Pricing-pattern selector allows switching between at least three patterns and updates on-screen cost previews immediately without persisting changes
Export wizard includes sampling option, estimated file size, and warning when selection exceeds backend export limit (UX matches engineering constraint)
Design spec includes keyboard nav and screen-reader notes for minimap rows and export controls
